newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA UNIONBANK HAS 216 MLN LEVS NET PROFIT 96.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA UNIONBANK HAS 216 MLN LEVS NET PROFIT 96.

text.p: Bulgaria's private Unionbank posted 215.8 million levs net profit for 1996 and decided to raise capital to 2.77 billion levs, the bank's executive director said.
"Unionbank posted 215.8 million levs net-profit for 1996 from a net income worth 5.2 billion levs after setting aside provisions and paying taxes," Ivan Radev told a news conference.
The bank's provisions amounted to 4.5 billion levs at the end of 1996. It posted 154.4 million levs net profit for 1995.
The bank's annual shareholders meeting on Saturday also decided to raise capital from current 990 million levs to 2.77 billion levs, Radev said.
To fund the increase the bank said it would transfer some 206 million levs of the net into share capital and will also transform 1.6 billion levs of reserves.
Some 10 million of the net are to be distributed as a three percent dividend among non-voting shareholders, Radev said.
Unionbank which has a one-tier management system and a full banking licence was launched as a successor to Sofia Financial House in late 1994. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
